title: Halo Dental header
description: Edge-to-edge top bar: paired-capsule emblem and wordmark on the left, a centred 6-item navigation row on desktop, and a white contrast CTA plus 40×40 locale and accessibility squares on the right. Phones show a compact white CTA and a three-line disclosure menu button.
notes: overlay (true by default) positions the header over the dark hero box and applies .dark token colours
Mobile navigation uses a native <details> element so it works in static HTML without JavaScript
